body.text: A dig or fill job that holds its gravel beside the square, with no depth change, can be a slow worker, not a stuck job: MiningSpeed is 0.1 at Mining 0 and 1.0 at Mining 8. Read jawa/pawn_stats MiningSpeed first. A proof that spawns a random Colonist for timed work sets Mining and asserts the speed.

The reach row sets the worker's Mining to 8 and requires MiningSpeed >= 0.5 (SITE). On game b: planted slow fill FAIL, real build PASS 5 of 5, worst 6 reads of 30 per notch. Mock: planted MiningSpeed 0.1 is red on the parent, green on the fix.

The island-restore fill stall was not JobDriver_FillInCanal's GotoCell(A, Touch) failing to finish from the diagonal stand square (172,225). That stand square worked in 6 of 6 runs with a known-skill worker. The stall was a slow random worker: MiningSpeed 0.1 at Mining 0 lays no notch in the 15000-tick wait.
